source: seytek-2012 printed page 981, first 40 verse rows
method: Line-by-line Kyrgyz-English review against the extracted 2012 printed text, with lexical checks and comparison to the 1960 parallel episode. Proposed readings require editorial review before release.
uncertainties: Line 3, кезет курап: the 1960 parallel reads Сурап турду Куялы; 'calling for her turn' is contextual and should be checked against the printed page.
Line 7, Одураңдап ороюп: the 1960 parallel reads Одурандап ороп; 'blustering and looming' conveys the scene but its precise second verb is provisional.
Lines 28-30: helmet syntax and the rare көмөрүп deserve a fluent Kyrgyz editor's review; the 1960 edition has Көмкөрүп башта кийилүү.
Line 32, себели: the protective-armor sense of себил is supported lexically, but the printed morphology is unusual; inspect original typesetting before release.
Line 38, катылган: context supports challenging or attacking, not hiding; precise agent relation with line 39 remains poetic and should be reviewed.

corrections.en: If you are Sarybay the warrior.
corrections.reason: Эр is the warrior epithet, not the English honorific 'Mr.'; carries the conditional begun in line 1.
Кезет refers to the combat turn in the preceding speech, and Куялы is the named actor; provisional phrase checked against 1960 parallel.
Келип жетти gives Sarybay's approach in the duel scene, not a generic announcement of arrival.

corrections.en: Here is how the fight went.
corrections.reason: Кериш is the fight; момундай means 'like this,' not 'humble.'
Кудай урганы is an idiomatic divine condemnation; the following lines portray his wrath.
Одураңдап is boisterous or blustering and the line describes Sarybay, not an instruction; second verb is provisional.
Сөзгө келбей means unwilling to heed words or negotiate.

corrections.en: As if he could reap and gather all,
corrections.reason: Оруп-жыйып contains both reaping and gathering, in the hyperbolic description of Sarybay.

corrections.old: To the bottom of the world
corrections.en: As far as the world's end
corrections.reason: Дүнүйөнүн түбүнө marks the farthest reach of the world; joins the next line's verb.

corrections.en: As if he alone could reach it,
corrections.reason: Жалгыз өзү is 'he alone'; жетчүдөй supplies the reaching action.

corrections.en: As if to shatter the whole world,
corrections.reason: Ай-ааламды талкалап is the first half of a conditional simile completed in line 13.

corrections.old: As if it would be destroyed.
corrections.reason: Талкан кылып is to crush or pulverize; the subject remains Sarybay.
Каарланды is became wrathful; punctuation links the ensuing description.

corrections.old: The way of fighting is humble.
corrections.en: Such was the course of the fight.
corrections.reason: Момундай means 'like this' and кагыш is clash or fight, not humility.
Traditional cosmic count is carried as the object of ruining in line 17.

corrections.en: He seemed able to lay waste,
corrections.reason: Опот кылып means bring to ruin or destruction, not make fire.
Ай-ааламдын баарысын means the entirety of the universe and joins line 19's verb.

corrections.old: As if he knew how to do it.
corrections.reason: Опот кылып repeats the ruin image; билчүдөй conveys apparent capacity.

corrections.old: Without getting used to what he said,
corrections.en: Refusing to heed what she said,
corrections.reason: Айтканына көнбөстөн means not consenting to what Kuyaly said.
Эр кезегин refers to the combat turn demanded in the prior speech.
Кара жаак qualifies айбалта, an axe with a black socket or cheek; the weapon was omitted.
Кармап алып is seize; имерди adds a swinging or circling movement.

corrections.en: Before the champion could ready herself,
corrections.reason: Камынтпастан is without allowing preparation; балбанды is the object, Kuyaly.

corrections.en: He brought it down with a crash.
corrections.reason: Карсылдатып expresses the cracking impact of Sarybay's axe strike.
Жаңжалын is his strife or quarrelsome conduct, known to Kuyaly in the next line.

corrections.en: She had known for a long time;
corrections.reason: Ар качандан билүүчү means had long known, with Kuyaly as the implied subject.
Көпкөк is intensely blue; темир is iron, not multicolored.
Көрсөң is a discourse marker ('you see'); арстан балбан describes Kuyaly.

corrections.en: Wore pulled down over her head;
corrections.reason: Көмөрүп башта кийүүчү describes wearing the helmet over the head, not charcoal; precise verb is provisional.
Камбыл is an adjective meaning prepared, capable or resourceful, not a personal name.
Себил denotes protective battle clothing; the line names her rib protection, with unusual printed form себели.
Айдалы means shoulders or shoulder blades, not 'soul.'

corrections.en: She had covered as she came;
corrections.reason: Каптап коюп келүүчү is she came having covered them; continues the armor detail.
Балбан is a champion in combat and the past narrative tense is natural here.

corrections.en: For a spear thrust to enter,
corrections.reason: Басып найза кирүүгө concerns a spear penetrating her armor, not stepping into a spear.
Бир жеринде тешик жок is an absolute absence of gaps in her armor.
Катылган means challenged or assailed in this combat context, not hidden.

corrections.old: There is no delay in Sarybay.
corrections.reason: Кешик жок is an idiom for ill fortune, not lack of delay.

corrections.old: Without getting used to the word,
corrections.reason: Сөзгө көнбөстөн means refusing to consent or listen.
